title: A failed krn task publish leaves a worktree that blocks the retry
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16: krn task publish failed on a red pre-push check (t-y9gvftp) and left .krn/worktrees/task-records-t-4gezbg6; the retry exited 64 'lane task-records-t-4gezbg6 already exists' until krn lane drop removed it.
Outcome: a failed krn task publish removes its own worktree and branch (or a retry reuses it), so a second publish after the fix exits 0 without a manual drop; a test covers the retry.
Proof: node --test test/cli/task-publish.test.ts: pass (publish fails on a refusing pre-push, then succeeds on retry without krn lane drop)
Files: src/task/, src/cli/
